reviews.text:
When I went here it was on a Saturday & was glad they were opened & close to home. The front staff was friendly & Dr. Choi was awesome. He was patient, listened & didn't rush you. I got seen quickly & even though I was referred out it was under $100 for the visit. Now days your charged $150 just to walk in the door. I will be going back with both my dogs for health issues
Anyway, I would recommend NVVC if your looking for reasonable prices & doctors who care for your pet & you.
They were kind and cured my kitten's infection.

First of all - Dr. Franke is a GOD!!! He has unbelievable patience and kindness, in addition to being an extremely skilled surgeon and a wonderful vet. I would trust him with my life. He is willing to take as much time as necessary to make sure you understand exactly what the issue is and how he will resolve it. Also, there is a front desk staff member named Jessica. Staff do not wear name tags here, but she has super short black hair and the cutest big dimples - which she flashes often! If you are lucky enough to have her help you check in, you will have a fantastic day! Thank you North Valley Veterinary Clinic for having Dr. Franke as a vet. He provides not only first-class animal care but also gives hope and comfort to the animal owners. BEST VET EVER!!!!!
We have been taking our cats there for care since 1985 and we have been nothing but pleased with their care.
Everytime I go it's clean and the staff is great

Dr.Franke and the amazing staff were incredibly professional. They took really good care of my  very nervous Anatolian Shepard. My dog is a giant breed and difficult to handle. This establishment was patient, attentive, professional, and nonjudgmental. I regret not bringing my dog here sooner.

TERRIBLE PLACE! Stay away from here. They disrespected my cat and myself. The Asian Lady Doctor was so rude with me. Never coming here again. They charged me $89 for a 2 minute visit. I myself had to weigh my cat down because the stupid nurse guy was scared of my cat. My cat isn't going to bite them nor hurt them?? The doctor tells me that she's uncomfortable with my cat??? Terrible. Never coming here again.
Excellent job! Good price’ ! Gorgeous people 🙏🏼 …

North Valley  charged me $61.93 6 months after I gave them a Voucher for $300.00. They sent me to a collection agency... The invoice was $222.43, the voucher was $300.00 thats a $77.57 balance... how can I owe $61.93 if the balance was higher?

The voucher program did not pay $25 from the $222 (AFTER THE APPOINTMENT), that is what caused this issue NOT because I didnt pay $25 at the time of the appointment. The timeline matters. North Valley did NOT itemize the $25 that was NOT covered in the $300 voucher. The voucher program later did NOT pay the $222. This was NOT my fault. North Valley took me to collections when the issue was with the invoice and the voucher and what was not covered NOT with me. I was NOT aware that I owed any money at the time of the appointment and there is NO proof, evidence, documentation, facts, invoice or any other reason to believe I owed $25.
FIX YOUR HOURS!!! super misleading with wrong hours posted on the internet versus the website of your vet. 🤦‍♀️ …
Very friendly staff an very reasonable prices ...
Nice veterinarian clinic. Easy to get an appointment and prices are doable. They will refer for larger issues. Can clean and extract teeth.

Find a better vet

Their regular service rates increased 50% without notice

They ignore pain, and I'm disappointed that they went to school to know that animals have nerves and pain, just like us to ignore it.

Shameful overall sense of entitlement in the office staff, with no compassion or humanity.

Try somewhere else.
Love this office! The doctors take such good care of all my animals, from my senior kitty who needs a lot of TLC to my little dogs! Clean and very reasonable prices which helps so much!
